[LGRA.3.2] If present, `use` must be the first non-comment,
non-blank statement. A `use` preceded by any other statement is a
compile error. Where an `import` precedes the `use`, [LIMP.2.3.3]
is the more specific rule and the compiler must raise its error
rather than this clause's. Whether a file has a `use` is what makes it a
program or a library ([LDIA.2.10.1]).
